% Checks cases that a fix of references to appendix chapters must not
% break: an article's appendix sections, with hyperref and cleveref.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{cleveref}
\begin{document}
\section{Main}\label{main}
Ref: \ref{app:a}; \ref{app:b}; \ref{sub:a}; \ref{main}.

Cref: \cref{app:a}; \Cref{sub:a}.
\appendix
\section{Extra}\label{app:a}
\subsection{More}\label{sub:a}
\section{Second extra}\label{app:b}
Text of the second appendix.
\end{document}
